Subject: Two-way calendar sync

Hi there!

I'm the founder at Velloran SAS. Please add two-way sync with Outlook calendars; today only Google Calendar is supported.

We are deciding whether to roll the app out to more teams this quarter. Meetings that are moved in Outlook are often missed in the app.

We would like this sorted before the end of the week. Is this on the roadmap?

Cheers,
[NAME_1]

Subject: Feature request: dark theme

Hi,

Writing on behalf of Hollowfen Media. It would be great to have a dark mode in the web app.

The mobile app already has one, so the web app feels inconsistent. Several people on our team have asked for it.

Let us know if it is planned.

Best,
[NAME_1]

Subject: API rate limits on our plan

Hi there!

Our nightly sync job is hitting 429 responses, and I need to know the API rate limits for the Business plan so we can pace the requests.

I could not find the limits in the API reference. The job is blocked until we know how to pace it.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Please point me to the right page.

Thanks so much!
[NAME_1]

Subject: Scheduled reports arrive an hour late

Good morning,

Writing on behalf of Glimmerbrook BV. Since the daylight saving change, our scheduled reports arrive an hour later than the time we set.

We can send the reports by hand in the meantime.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Please let us know if we need to change anything.

Yours sincerely,
[NAME_1]
